extracted_information: The provided content describes the Hemingway Editor desktop app and its 'Hemingway Editor Plus' service. The classic desktop app allows saving/loading files, works offline, and does not use AI. It highlights writing issues like lengthy/complex sentences (yellow/red), complex words (purple), and adverbs/passive voice (blue). The 'Hemingway Editor Plus' service is an AI-powered add-on that fixes highlights, includes an advanced grammar checker (green highlights), and offers AI tools for tone/style changes. No information regarding pricing or its open-source status is available in the provided text.

specifications.ai_integration: No (classic desktop app), Yes (Hemingway Editor Plus service)

features.name: Sentence Complexity Highlighting
features.description: Highlights lengthy/complex sentences in yellow for shortening/splitting, and very dense/complicated sentences in red for significant re-editing.

features.name: Word Simplicity Suggestions
features.description: Highlights complex words in purple, suggesting simpler alternatives.

features.name: Weakening Phrase Identification
features.description: Marks adverbs, passive voice, and other weakening phrases in blue for replacement with more forceful language.

features.name: File Management
features.description: Ability to save and load files.

features.name: Offline Work
features.description: Allows users to work without an internet connection.

features.name: AI-Powered Highlight Fixing (Hemingway Editor Plus)
features.description: Uses AI to automatically fix identified writing issues.

features.name: Advanced Grammar Checker (Hemingway Editor Plus)
features.description: Identifies and marks grammar issues in green, including tricky errors beyond typical grammar tools.

features.name: AI Tone/Style Tools (Hemingway Editor Plus)
features.description: Provides AI-driven tools to change the tone or style of selected text.
